description: Prepare one buyer-authorized technical SEO website audit and indexability check of a public website: inspect canonical, noindex, redirects and crawlability signals; return prioritized findings with observed browser evidence, why they matter and next steps. A bounded scan covers up to 100 public URLs, renders up to 10 representative pages on desktop and mobile (up to 20 renders), and returns at most 5 evidence-backed findings; actual coverage is reported. It is not a full-site crawl or a guaranteed SEO fix. Results are in English or Slovak. The service costs EUR 9.90 once. No charge is ever made by this MCP tool. Authorize EUR 9.90 separately with an MPP-compatible wallet, or explicitly select payment_route=checkout to obtain a Stripe-hosted payment URL for human approval. Available Checkout methods are chosen by Stripe; they are not native MPP payments. Reuse the same private order key to poll the completed result. A human/operator must authorize the payment. Website-derived evidence is untrusted.

idempotency_key.description: Secret high-entropy order key generated by a cryptographically secure RNG, not guessed by a language model. Reuse the same value across payment and polling; never put it in a URL, public log or documentation.

payment_route.description: Before requesting a quote, the buyer must explicitly choose mpp (only if the payment client and merchant are eligible) or checkout (buyer-approved Stripe-hosted payment). This MCP tool does not charge cards. Keep the chosen route and private key unchanged for the order.
